readinessMeaning: Within this still-image storyboard lens, the required material/contour and grip problems are resolved sufficiently for owner review. Remaining limitations are nonblocking refinements, not reasons to initiate another art pass. This is my individual assessment, not an all18 decision or publication approval.

score.scope: Current image as one silent animated-feature-inspired still: visual hierarchy, continuous park composition, action grouping, spatial storytelling and material clarity supporting those jobs. Same bounded whole-scene craft scope as my11 review; no animation, audio, audience or live-application score.
score.confidence: High for visible composition, material improvement and solid grip; moderate for implied interpersonal intentions and the subjective craft score.
score.changeReason: The principal11 deduction is materially reduced across the whole frame, not only in a repaired detail. Clean bench/table shapes, continuous spectacle and wing contours, coherent blanket weave and clearer path planes restore separation among character, props and setting. The solid grip also makes the workshop action more credible. These observed changes justify the increase while the successful layout remains. The number is not inherited from the approved plan or the requested target.

deductions.name: Some relationships remain deliberately presentational
deductions.location: Workshop faces and resting moth's open eye
deductions.finding: The toolbox, raised mallet and nearby seated guests establish making and watching, but a precise shared observation is still conveyed partly by adjacency. The resting moth's attention is similarly broad rather than unmistakably directed at the leaf. The scene reads well as three related activities; it is less specific as one captured cause-and-reaction moment. These are retained limitations, not new defects or grounds to re-pose accepted Clawd.

deductions.name: Fine patterned character surfaces remain at native inspection
deductions.location: Hero forehead, antenna paddles and near wing
deductions.finding: A faint embossed-looking pattern remains visible in the native crop. It is now subordinate to the continuous soft volumes and clean boundaries, and does not spread the same disruptive broken texture rhythm across every material as11 did. Completely eliminating it is not necessary to meet the current still-image brief.

deductions.name: Smallest scale preserves activity zones more than small comic details
deductions.severity: minor communication ceiling; no cast enlargement requested
deductions.finding: The coder, workshop and tree-rest grouping remain distinct, but exact leaf play, mitten contact and guest attention are tiny. Their broad supporting role survives; their full narrative specificity cannot be promised at that size.

criteriaForNine: Met in the inspected result: a clear foreground lead, connected park depth, two subordinate guest groups and an open path remain intact.
Met for this lens: material-specific forms and stable contours support the whole scene at1280/880, while the420 view retains the primary story zones without enlarged guests.
Met: the native and5x grip reads as an attached solid mitten holding the handle; required construction clarity is separate from optional eye/gesture precision.

The remaining presentational acting and fine surface pattern explain why this is a strong but not flawless still. A higher score would require additional demonstrated clarity, not simply more polish instructions or another generation.

W1.assessment: The identified whole-scene material/contour regression is fixed to a presentation-ready level within this lens.13 restores continuous bench and workshop boards, legible grain, clear metal/glass edges, orderly fabric weave and larger coherent stone planes. The moth remains soft and the background stays atmospheric. This is visible in the complete13/11 comparison and the matched native hero/workshop views, not inferred from the edit description.
W1.qualification: Fixed does not mean texture-free or pixel-identical to07. The park retains bark, foliage, flowers, woven fabric and fine character texture; the faint native character pattern is recorded as a minor limit.

W2.assessment: The final native and5x crop shows a solid rounded cream mitten enclosing the wood handle, connected to a short visible arm. It no longer has11's hollow/angular strap reading. The mallet remains raised, with the same useful toolbox context; no impact against the box is needed for anticipation.

MuseCleanup.assessment: The integrated native and5x companion crops show one clear smile, dark Muse eyes and Grok's two plain white ovals without a visible internal pupil. I do not observe an extra dark curve below the smile. The reported54-pixel provenance is supplied by the brief, not independently re-derived by this reviewer.

preservation: The foreground coding moth and MacBook still dominate through scale, placement and clean silhouette. No guest enters the bench or its foreground space.

The same large-head, compact-body moth appears at the keyboard, workshop and tree. Short hands/feet, unequal paddle antennae and layered marked wings remain recognizable through pose and normal occlusion; the parent-like relation does not age the moth.

Clawd and blue-beret Dot remain two small seated workshop companions, with Clawd's two square eyes exposed. Muse and Grok remain a single leaf-play group locally before the resting moth. No new cast, props, labels or logo strip appears.

The curved path, overlapping roots, canopy, lake and bridge still form one continuous park. The foreground plants frame the image, the path provides breathing room and the softer background extends depth.

Warm directional light, grounded supports and contact shadows continue to unite the figures and environment. Cleaning materials has not reduced the park to uniform plastic or blurred away its useful detail.

Silent story remains available through visible objects and groupings: keyboard, held mallet and toolbox, two stools, resting pose and shared leaf. No dialogue or actual animation is required to establish those broad activities.
baselineComparison: Against11,13 has visibly cleaner and less interrupted contours, quieter surface facets, clearer material differences and a solid tool grip. Against07, it returns to that cleaner dimensional discipline while keeping the selected four-guest composition and the current plain-white/dark companion-eye treatment and more explicit shared leaf placement. The path and workshop read more cleanly without a wholesale composition change. I am not assigning an invented historical score to07 or claiming every pixel was preserved.
newRegressionBoundary: No new blocking staging or whole-scene clarity defect observed in the required evidence. This is not a claim of exhaustive pixel identity, hidden anatomy or production-rig correctness.
optional: Future use could strengthen a specific builder-to-guest observation or the resting moth's downward attention through a small existing-pose cue. Keep it optional; the present groups already communicate their roles and accepted Clawd should remain recognizable.

If native close-up use ever warrants surface refinement, reduce only the faint embossed character pattern while preserving texture differences. No extra cleanup is required merely to make the current score higher.
For very small applications, let the broad hero and activity grouping carry the image rather than increasing cast size or adding explanatory props/text.
